data: DO $$ BEGIN IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM test_case_tag_link link JOIN test_case_tag case_tag ON case_tag.id = link.tag_id JOIN test_case testcase ON testcase.id = link.testcase_id WHERE testcase.space_id <> case_tag.space_id) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'v30 cannot unify test-case tags: legacy case/tag links cross Space boundaries'; END IF; END $$

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS test_case_tag_link_shared (id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), testcase_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES test_case(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, tag_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES tagmodel(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, CONSTRAINT uq_test_case_tag_link_shared_pair UNIQUE (testcase_id, tag_id))
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_test_case_tag_link_shared_tag ON test_case_tag_link_shared (tag_id, testcase_id)

CREATE TEMP TABLE _v30_case_tag_map (case_tag_id UUID PRIMARY KEY, shared_tag_id UUID NOT NULL, was_created BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE, ambiguous_match BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE) ON COMMIT DROP
CREATE TEMP TABLE _v30_case_tag_missing (case_tag_id UUID PRIMARY KEY, space_id UUID NOT NULL, name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL) ON COMMIT DROP

INSERT INTO _v30_case_tag_map (case_tag_id, shared_tag_id, ambiguous_match) SELECT old_tag.id, COALESCE(exact_match.id, normalized_match.id), (exact_match.match_count > 1 OR (exact_match.id IS NULL AND normalized_match.match_count > 1)) FROM test_case_tag old_tag LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT tag.id, COUNT(*) OVER () AS match_count FROM tagmodel tag WHERE tag.space_id = old_tag.space_id AND tag.title = old_tag.name ORDER BY tag.create_date ASC, tag.id ASC LIMIT 1) exact_match ON TRUE LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT tag.id, COUNT(*) OVER () AS match_count FROM tagmodel tag WHERE tag.space_id = old_tag.space_id AND lower(btrim(tag.title)) = lower(btrim(old_tag.name)) ORDER BY tag.create_date ASC, tag.id ASC LIMIT 1) normalized_match ON TRUE WHERE COALESCE(exact_match.id, normalized_match.id) IS NOT NULL

INSERT INTO _v30_case_tag_missing (case_tag_id, space_id, name) SELECT old_tag.id, old_tag.space_id, old_tag.name FROM test_case_tag old_tag LEFT JOIN _v30_case_tag_map mapped ON mapped.case_tag_id = old_tag.id WHERE mapped.case_tag_id IS NULL
INSERT INTO tagmodel (id, create_date, title, color, space_id) SELECT gen_random_uuid(), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, missing.name, NULL, missing.space_id FROM _v30_case_tag_missing missing

INSERT INTO _v30_case_tag_map (case_tag_id, shared_tag_id, was_created) SELECT missing.case_tag_id, matched.id, TRUE FROM _v30_case_tag_missing missing JOIN LATERAL (SELECT tag.id FROM tagmodel tag WHERE tag.space_id = missing.space_id AND tag.title = missing.name ORDER BY tag.create_date ASC, tag.id ASC LIMIT 1) matched ON TRUE

DO $$ BEGIN IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM test_case_tag old_tag LEFT JOIN _v30_case_tag_map mapped ON mapped.case_tag_id = old_tag.id WHERE mapped.case_tag_id IS NULL) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'v30 failed to resolve every legacy test-case tag'; END IF; END $$

INSERT INTO test_case_tag_link_shared (id, testcase_id, tag_id) SELECT gen_random_uuid(), link.testcase_id, mapped.shared_tag_id FROM test_case_tag_link link JOIN _v30_case_tag_map mapped ON mapped.case_tag_id = link.tag_id JOIN test_case testcase ON testcase.id = link.testcase_id JOIN test_case_tag old_tag ON old_tag.id = mapped.case_tag_id JOIN tagmodel shared_tag ON shared_tag.id = mapped.shared_tag_id WHERE shared_tag.space_id = testcase.space_id ON CONFLICT (testcase_id, tag_id) DO NOTHING

DO $$ DECLARE source_links BIGINT; transferred_pairs BIGINT; created_tags BIGINT; reused_tags BIGINT; ambiguous_matches BIGINT; BEGIN SELECT COUNT(*) INTO source_links FROM test_case_tag_link; SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT (link.testcase_id, mapped.shared_tag_id)) INTO transferred_pairs FROM test_case_tag_link link JOIN _v30_case_tag_map mapped ON mapped.case_tag_id = link.tag_id; SELECT COUNT(*) INTO created_tags FROM _v30_case_tag_map WHERE was_created; SELECT COUNT(*) INTO reused_tags FROM _v30_case_tag_map WHERE NOT was_created; SELECT COUNT(*) INTO ambiguous_matches FROM _v30_case_tag_map WHERE ambiguous_match; RAISE NOTICE 'v30 test-case tags: source_links=%, transferred_distinct_pairs=%, shared_tags_created=%, shared_tags_reused=%, ambiguous_matches=%', source_links, transferred_pairs, created_tags, reused_tags, ambiguous_matches; IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM test_case_tag_link link JOIN _v30_case_tag_map mapped ON mapped.case_tag_id = link.tag_id JOIN test_case testcase ON testcase.id = link.testcase_id JOIN tagmodel shared_tag ON shared_tag.id = mapped.shared_tag_id WHERE testcase.space_id <> shared_tag.space_id) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'v30 produced a cross-Space test-case tag link'; END IF; END $$
